key_highlights: The Australian sharemarket suffered a severe drawdown wiping $169 billion in value, driven by aggressive monetary tightening concerns and risk aversion.
Growing scrutiny over whether five RBA rate hikes have excessively impaired consumer borrowing capacity, triggering an accelerating housing downturn.
Australian dollar faces acute weakness against the USD, heightening imported inflation risks while benefiting unhedged offshore commodity earnings.
Retail sector turbulence escalates with David Jones cutting nearly 1,700 jobs as Myer aggressively poaches market share and suppliers ahead of Black Friday.
Governance and conflict-of-interest concerns hit major banking as KPMG faces scrutiny over NAB's payroll underpayment remediation.

sectors.trend: Credit expansion deceleration and heightened asset quality risk as cumulative RBA hikes suppress mortgage demand and fuel residential price falls.
sectors.implications: Net interest margin compression and credit loss provisioning pressure ahead for major banks, compounded by governance headaches at NAB.

sectors.trend: Severe bifurcation in discretionary retail alongside structural diet shifts altering staples demand via GLP-1 weight-loss therapeutics.
sectors.implications: Myer (MYR.AX) gains competitive tailwinds from David Jones restructuring, while supermarket majors (WOW.AX, COL.AX) face evolving basket volumes.

sectors.trend: Resilience in junior gold project restarts, critical minerals exploration, and targeted capital raisings despite broader equity sell-offs.
sectors.implications: Gold developers benefit from safe-haven demand; breakthrough rare earth recoveries enhance project feasibility for emerging producers.

sectors.trend: Grid vulnerability highlighted by extreme weather blackouts; transition timetable faces headwinds from COP31 deadlocks and Snowy Hydro 2.0 scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Elevated reliability expenditure required for domestic utilities; policy uncertainty continues to cloud long-term fossil fuel phase-out assets.

sectors.trend: Accelerating enterprise AI adoption driving white-collar layoffs and offshoring while attracting selective venture and secondary market capital.
sectors.implications: Cost rationalisation across service sectors, though national security elevation of AI points to upcoming regulatory and sovereign compliance mandates.

key_themes: Monetary policy overshoot: Intensifying consensus that RBA tightening is damaging residential property equity and household solvency.
Sovereign currency vulnerability: Depreciated AUD testing import margins and challenging domestic inflationary stabilization.
Corporate restructuring: Accelerated retail and service sector headcount rationalisation in response to demand destruction and AI automation.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Accelerating Housing Price Collapse and Mortgage Stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight domestic retail banks heavily geared to Australian residential mortgages; allocate to diversified corporate lenders.
Increase exposure to global unhedged USD earners across resources (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) and healthcare (CSL.AX).

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Major Bank Governance and Regulatory Penalties
risk_assessment.mitigation: Demand higher risk premia on Tier 1 bank capital and monitor APRA supervisory responses to underpayment scandals.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Household Spending Contraction and Retail Defaults
risk_assessment.mitigation: Limit exposure to mid-tier discretionary retailers exposed to discretionary household income cuts.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical Long in Myer Following Competitor Layoffs
opportunities.rationale: David Jones's deep staff cuts and restructuring provide Myer immediate market share, customer footfall, and supplier acquisition upside.
Gold capital raisings and WA mine restarts offer robust inflation hedging and capital upside amid equity market volatility.

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into Defensive USD-Earning Large-Cap Exporters
opportunities.rationale: Weak AUD delivers an earnings tailwind for unhedged global commodity exporters and healthcare multinational operations.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Exposure to Big Four Mortgage Lenders
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising borrowing costs, mortgage contraction, severe housing market drops, and governance scrutiny threaten credit growth and ROE.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge General Equity Downside on the ASX 200
defensive_moves.rationale: Following the $169B weekly wipeout, continued weakness in consumer and housing metrics signals further downside index pressure.

market_outlook.short_term: Cautious to Bearish (1–3 months). ASX 200 remains vulnerable to further valuation compression as five rate hikes depress property values and consumer sentiment.
market_outlook.long_term: Neutral (6–12 months). A potential RBA policy pause and sustained demand for gold and critical minerals could provide stabilization, though macro debt overhangs will constrain upside.

Black Friday and Christmas retail sales updates
Monthly employment report assessing labour market loosening
Iron ore benchmark prices and China property stimulus measures
watch_list: RBA cash rate expectations and commentary
Sydney and Melbourne residential dwelling value indices
Gold spot price and ASX gold miner performance
